args.title: Correct the setup steps in the README
args.body:
File: README.md

The setup section of the README incorrectly lists `npm run serve` as a command, but this script does not exist. This should likely be replaced with the correct command to start the application after building, or an alternative method should be documented if different. This change ensures users can execute the local setup steps as instructed.
